The Gatesmasher is a wilder who resonates with the energy patterns of gates and portals, and learns to manipulate them.

**Commune with Portal (Su):** Starting at 2nd level, your intuition supersedes gives you an uncanny connection to portals.You gains a +2 insight bonus to her Spellcraft and Use Magic Device checks made on interplanar gates and portals. This bonus increases by 1 every 4 levels thereafter (+3 at 6th level, +4 at 10th level, etc).

This ability replaces elude attack.

**Planar Conduit (Su):** You gain Overchannel, Planar Sensitivity, and Talent as bonus feats at 1st level, even if you do not meet the requirements. his ability replaces wild surge, psychic enervation, and surge bond.

**Randomize Portal (Su):** You can emit a blast of psychoportation energy that disrupts portals and gates. You can, as a standard action, expend your psionic focus to randomize the destination of one interplanar portal for one round per point of your Charisma modifier.

Anyone who passes through the portal from either side is sent to a random plane rather than the portal’s intended destination unless they make a Will save, DC equal to your wilder level plus your Charisma bonus. All those who fail the save go to the same location on the same plane.

At 4th level and every three levels thereafter, the duration increases by 2 rounds.

This ability replaces surge blast.

**Who Needs Keys? (Su):** Your understanding of planar forces extends to the workings of gates and portals, such that you may force them open without the correct device, spell, or key. You make a Disable Device check as if opening a lock, using your Charisma modifier instead of your Dexterity modifier. This is a full-round action. The portal remains open for 1d4+1 rounds afterward.

This ability replaces surging euphoria.

**See The Gate (Su):** You see a faint nimbus of light around the edges of gates, portals, and other means of crossing planar boundaries.

This ability replaces the improved surge bond gained at 5th level.

**Psionic Meditation (Su):** You gain the Psionic Meditation feat even if you do not meet the requirements.

This ability replaces the improved surge bond gained at 9th level.

**Redirect Portal (Su):** You can, as a standard action, expend your psionic focus to redirect the destination of one interplanar portal for two rounds per point of your Charisma modifier. Anyone who passes through the portal from either side is sent to a specific plane that you determine rather than the portal’s intended destination unless they make a Will save, DC equal to your wilder level plus your Charisma bonus. All those who fail the save go to the same location on the same plane.

At 15th level and every two levels thereafter, the duration increases by 2 rounds.

This ability replaces the improved surge bond gained at 13th level.

**Living Portal (Su):** Three times daily, as a move action, you may move across planar boundaries as though using planar travel.

This ability replaces the improved surge bond gained at 17th level.
